text:
You need a custom application that compares Bing Ads search query data against a white list and automatically adds matching negative keywords.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. In a recent project, Parent survey analysis, I cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response survey using Python, pandas, and Excel, and 3 findings were adopted in the next funding plan. In Subscription churn cohorts, I built monthly retention curves by signup cohort and plan, plus an onboarding funnel using SQL, PostgreSQL, Python, pandas, and Looker Studio; one onboarding step was linked to 40% of first-month churn.

I can help structure the query comparison logic, support secure data handling, and document the workflow clearly. What criteria should determine when a query gets added as a negative keyword?
